nodes.description: Constant state variable holding the Sushiswap V1 oracle interface address used as an external price source.
Constant state variable holding the Uniswap V1 oracle interface address used as an external price source.
Constant address of WETH, used as the intermediate/quote asset in conversions.
Constant address of DAI, used as the USD-denominated quote asset.
Public view function converting an asset amount to USD by chaining assetToEth then ethToUsd.
Public view function converting an asset amount to ETH; returns 0 for zero amount, passes through WETH, otherwise queries quote().
Public view function averaging Sushiswap and Uniswap oracle TWAP quotes of a token against WETH.
Public view function averaging Sushiswap and Uniswap oracle TWAP quotes of WETH against DAI.
External call to sushiswapV1Oracle.quote() inside quote(); return value is attacker/externally influenced.
External call to uniswapV1Oracle.quote() inside quote(); return value is externally influenced.
External call to sushiswapV1Oracle.quote() inside ethToUsd(); return value is externally influenced.
External call to uniswapV1Oracle.quote() inside ethToUsd(); return value is externally influenced.
Parameter asset of assetToUsd: address of the token to convert.
Parameter amount of assetToUsd: amount of the token to convert.
Parameter granularity of assetToUsd: TWAP observation window size.
Parameter asset of assetToEth: address of the token to convert to ETH.
Parameter amount of assetToEth: amount of the token to convert.
Parameter granularity of assetToEth: TWAP observation window size.
Parameter tokenIn of quote: input token of the oracle TWAP query.
Parameter amountIn of quote: input amount of the oracle TWAP query.
Parameter granularity of quote: TWAP observation window size.
Parameter ethAmount of ethToUsd: amount of ETH to price in DAI.
Parameter granularity of ethToUsd: TWAP observation window size.
